T: Make the cake without magic. Good luck.
D: A princess cursed by Maleficent is hidden in the forest by three good fairies until her sixteenth birthday.
P: Serve dessert when the fairies try to bake the birthday cake without magic.
S: King Hubert's wedding toast cheese board
King Hubert and King Stefan toasting the wedding plans

Aged cheddar, gooey baked brie and blue cheese with honey-roasted walnuts, quince paste, grapes and crackers, built for two kings toasting a wedding. Toss 100g walnuts with 1 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt and roast at 180C for 8 minutes, then cool. Score the top of a 200g brie wheel, drizzle with honey and thyme and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until wobbly. Set it on a big board with 200g aged cheddar in shards, 150g blue cheese, 150g quince paste, the walnuts, 300g grapes and crackers.
Pink beetroot yoghurt dip and blue cheese sour cream dip, pita crisps
Two dips side by side: beetroot whipped with yoghurt for pink, and blue cheese with sour cream for blue, with pita crisps.
M: King Stefan's crackling pork with apples
the celebration in King Stefan's castle

Fennel and salt rubbed pork shoulder roasted low then blasted for shattering crackling, with roast apples, crispy potatoes and a mustard apple gravy. Score the skin of a 2kg pork shoulder, dry well and rub with 1 tbsp crushed fennel seeds and plenty of salt. Roast at 160C for 3.5 hours, adding 1kg potato chunks and 4 quartered apples for the last hour. Turn the oven to 240C for 20 minutes until the crackling blisters. Rest 15 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 300ml apple juice, 200ml stock and 1 tsp mustard and simmer until thick.
Beef chuck simmered with carrots, parsnips, onion and thyme
Beef chuck simmered 3 hours with onion, carrots, parsnips and thyme until tender, served with crusty bread and butter.
W: The fairies' no magic birthday cake
Three vanilla layers stacked with raspberry jam and buttercream
Vanilla sponge baked in three tins at 175C for 25 minutes, stacked high with jam and buttercream, iced pink and blue and left proudly a little crooked.
Lots of berries, white chocolate dipped
Strawberries and blackberries dipped in white chocolate, raspberry dust
Strawberries and blackberries dipped in melted white chocolate, set on baking paper and dusted with a little freeze-dried raspberry.
K: Pomegranate and orange juice with cinnamon syrup

Sparkling apple and pomegranate punch with orange, cinnamon syrup and pomegranate seeds, poured into goblets for a royal toast of skumps. Simmer 3 tbsp sugar and 3 tbsp water with 1 cinnamon stick for 3 minutes, then cool. In a jug, mix 300ml pomegranate juice, the juice of 1 orange and the cinnamon syrup. Add 1 sliced orange and the seeds of half a pomegranate. Just before serving, add ice and top with 750ml chilled sparkling apple juice. Pour into goblets and raise them high.

s.note: Briar Rose was sent for berries, not mushrooms.

d.note: Flora says pink. Merryweather says blue.

dishes.n: Lots of berries, white chocolate dipped

steps.text: Melt the white chocolate gently in a heatproof bowl over simmering water.
Dip the strawberries and blackberries halfway and set on baking paper.
While still wet, dust with the crushed freeze-dried raspberries.
Chill until set.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep dips chilled

steps.text: Wrap the beetroot in foil and roast at 200C until tender, then peel.
Blend the beetroot with the yoghurt and garlic until bright pink.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream.
Cut the pita into wedges and brush with oil.
Bake the wedges at 180C until crisp.
Serve the dips side by side with the pita crisps.
Chop the beef and vegetables.
Brown the beef in batches in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onion, carrots, parsnips, thyme and enough water to cover.
Cover and simmer gently until tender.
Season and serve in bowls with crusty bread and butter.
Chop the mushrooms and vegetables.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onion, carrots, parsnips, lentils, thyme and enough stock to cover.
Cover and simmer gently until the vegetables are tender.
Season and serve in bowls with crusty bread and butter.

dishes.n: The fairies' no magic birthday cake
dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep iced cake covered

ingredients.item: pink and blue food colouring, a drop of each

steps.text: Beat the cake butter and sugar until pale, add the eggs one at a time, then fold in the flour.
Divide between 3 lined tins and bake at 175C until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool completely in the tins.
Beat the buttercream butter with the icing sugar until fluffy.
Stack the layers with jam and buttercream. Ice half pink and half blue and leave it proudly a little crooked.

dishes.make_ahead: Syrup up to 3 days, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Simmer the sugar, water and cinnamon stick for a few minutes to make a syrup.
Cool the syrup.
Juice one orange and slice the other. Mix the pomegranate juice, orange juice and syrup in a jug.
Add the orange slices and half the pomegranate seeds.
Just before serving, add the ice and top with the sparkling apple juice. Pour into goblets.

Woodcutter's cottage stew.veg: Field mushrooms and lentils simmered with carrots, parsnips, onion and thyme

s.note: Pink beetroot yoghurt dip and blue cheese sour cream dip, pita crisps
s.how: Blend 2 roasted beetroot with 200g Greek yoghurt and garlic until bright pink. Mash 100g blue cheese into 200ml sour cream. Serve side by side with warm pita crisps and let everyone argue about pink or blue.

m.note: Beef chuck simmered with carrots, parsnips, onion and thyme
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add a sliced onion, 3 carrots, 2 parsnips and thyme. Cover with water and simmer gently for 3 hours until tender. Serve in bowls with crusty bread and butter at a cottage in the woods.

w.n: The fairies' no magic birthday cake
w.note: Three vanilla layers stacked with raspberry jam and buttercream
w.how: Beat 300g butter with 300g sugar, add 5 eggs and fold in 300g self-raising flour. Bake in 3 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Stack with raspberry jam and buttercream, then ice half pink and half blue. Leave it proudly a little crooked.

w.n: Lots of berries, white chocolate dipped
w.note: Strawberries and blackberries dipped in white chocolate, raspberry dust
w.how: Melt 200g white chocolate. Dip 250g strawberries and 125g blackberries halfway and set on baking paper. While still wet, dust with crushed freeze-dried raspberries. Chill for 15 minutes and serve like a forest picnic.

d.note: Pomegranate and orange juice with cinnamon syrup
d.how: Simmer 3 tbsp sugar and 3 tbsp water with 1 cinnamon stick for 3 minutes, then cool. In a jug, mix 300ml pomegranate juice, the juice of 1 orange and the cinnamon syrup. Add 1 sliced orange and the seeds of half a pomegranate. Just before serving, add ice and top with 750ml chilled sparkling apple juice. Pour into goblets and raise them high.
